note: v2602: REG-583. The console emblem fell back to a second asset and when THAT failed re-set src to the SAME value - assigning src re-triggers the fetch, so a genuine 404 loops forever. Every other image in control_ui.html terminates (this.remove, display none, opacity 0); this was the only one that could not. AND THE LOOP HID ITSELF FROM THE GATE - while retrying, complete never settles true, so the standard broken-image test complete AND naturalWidth zero was structurally blind to it. Measured before - complete false, countedByAGate false. After - complete true, natural 0, countedByAGate true. Not a live regression - both assets exist at the repo root and the render target loads control_ui.html from file:// where a root-absolute /art path cannot resolve. Found because a cold cross-family look said NO broken images and I cropped the crest 6x and it was unmistakably the torn-picture placeholder - the first of three disagreements this session where I was the one who was right. NAMED NOT CLOSED - the render gate reports imgs 0 of 0 on this target so it examines zero images and would not have caught this either way.
